'''Teeana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] employee of the [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Invasion of Ziost]] in [[3636 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.2}}</ref> she was present at the GSI orbital station above the planet, from which she witnessed the devastation of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Teeana was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in game update 3.2.
